title: Overlays
summary: See-through graphics in light for footage, shown over the sample clip: a red dot fires the first line, shapes open from where it touches them, red marks the cause and a blue flash the result arriving. Thin lines with a white core and red/blue echoes; a faint pool of shade sits behind text (props.shade: 0 under the theme's night look, about 1 on bright ungraded footage; 0.3 by default). By default they keep to the top, bottom and edges so the face stays clear.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"piece": "overlays/fire-label", "start": 1.2, "end": 4.4, "props": {"label": "STEP 01", "sub": "WRITE THE CAPTION", "y": 420}}. Positions are in 1080×1920 frame pixels; every piece animates out before its end when the player passes `life`. viewfinder and haze can run the whole clip. Kit: library/themes/lines-of-light/kit.js. Files: library/themes/lines-of-light/overlays/pieces/.

items.name: Viewfinder
items.description: A viewfinder drawn in light round the safe area: the red dot fires the first corner bracket, the other three open in turn; a label, a running clock and a note sit inside. Runs for a whole clip.

items.name: Haze finish
items.description: The analog finish for a whole clip: footage sinks into near-black teal at the edges, faint stepped grain, two hairlines of light across the top and bottom of the safe zone.

items.name: Face lock
items.description: Corner brackets of light that lock onto the speaker's face and follow it, a red dot at the lock, a blue flash, and a label on a rule of light above. Uses the face track.

items.name: Red-dot label
items.description: The signature beat: a red dot fires a line down and across to a label; a rule opens under it and the label lands orange, red, white, with a mono sub-line.

items.name: Callout
items.description: A red dot beside a label fires an elbow line to a target spot; a ring opens round the target and flashes blue, an arrowhead draws in.

items.name: Tick or cross
items.description: A ring of light with a white tick that lands in a blue flash, or (mark: cross) two red strikes; a label lands below.

items.name: Struck out
items.description: A word lands under a line of light, a red strike crosses it out, and the replacement lands below in a blue flash.

items.name: Timeline, struck
items.description: The timeline beat: the red dot fires the timeline, ruler and clips draw, a red playhead lights each clip blue, then at the cue two red strikes cross it out, it collapses into a blue flash and NO TIMELINE lands alone.

items.name: Counter
items.description: A figure that counts up over the footage while it lands orange to white, on a rule fired by a red dot, with a kicker above, a label below and a blue flash at the final value.

items.name: Progress meter
items.description: A dim track of light with ticks, a bright line filling it led by a red pulse, the percentage counting in mono, a blue flash when it arrives.

items.name: Clock dial
items.description: A dial of light with sixty ticks; a red hand sweeps round leaving a trail, then a blue flash lands the value in the middle. Sits top-right by default.

items.name: Building list
items.description: A list that builds item by item on a spine of light: at each item's time a triple bar reaches out and the item lands with its number. The v1 rules list as an overlay.

items.name: Sunburst behind
items.description: Uneven rays fanning out across the upper half from behind the speaker's head, starting well outside the face; follows the face when tracked.

items.name: Horizon and sun
items.description: A horizon line opening from the centre, a setting sun rising as an arc of light with strands across it, a fan of rays and dashed reflections. Placed clear of the face when tracked: under the chin if the sun fits, otherwise above the head (y sets it by hand).
